response.sql: WITH matched_fees_orders AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.mktnote, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) as net_fee_rate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), pair_averages AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fee_rate FROM matched_fees_orders GROUP BY mktnote), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as benchmark_value FROM pair_averages), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pa.avg_net_fee_rate, b.benchmark_value FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL AND pa.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_value) SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as avg_of_avg_net_fee_rates, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_value) as avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM filtered_pairs
